title: Raku Party - November dates
evidence_sentence: The Raku Party page lists additional open dates in November for the same raku firing workshop.
evidence_quote: you glaze your chosen piece and watch it fired in a traditional Raku kiln
summary: Raku firing workshops offered on November 13 and November 27 (Thanksgiving weekend) with the same format: glaze a pre-made piece and watch the firing. Contact the gallery to book.
bring: Participants select from pre-made bisque pieces; safety gear provided
